SDSP.description: Specified Displacements of Supports (SDSP). Each node key holds one ITEMS array; every item pairs a static load case (LCNAME) with 6 local-direction displacement components (VALUES: Dx, Dy, Dz, Rx, Ry, Rz).

ITEMS.description: List of specified-displacement definitions for this support node, one per load case / load group combination.

ID.description: Serial number of the item within the node's union key. Optional; used to identify an existing record for replacement. If omitted/0, the record is matched by load case and load group.

LCNAME.description: Static load case name. Must reference an existing static load case; an invalid name is rejected at runtime.

GROUP_NAME.description: Load group name. Optional; empty string means no load group. If non-empty it must reference an existing load group, otherwise the request is rejected.

VALUES.description: Six local-direction displacement components in order [Dx, Dy, Dz, Rx, Ry, Rz]. The handler requires exactly 6 entries; each entry has a usage flag and a displacement value.

OPT_FLAG.description: Usage flag for this displacement component. true = the displacement is applied in this direction.

DISPLACEMENT.description: Specified displacement value in the local direction (translation for Dx/Dy/Dz, rotation for Rx/Ry/Rz).
